sub_strands.name: Quadratic Equations and Functions
performance_indicators: Solve quadratic equations using the quadratic formula and the method of completing the square.
Graph quadratic functions and determine their vertex, axis of symmetry, and intercepts.
Formulate and solve real-world optimization problems using quadratic models.

sub_strands.name: Trigonometric Functions and Sine/Cosine Laws
performance_indicators: Extend trigonometric ratios to angles of any magnitude using the unit circle.
Apply the Law of Sines and the Law of Cosines to solve non-right-angled triangles.
Prove basic trigonometric identities involving sine, cosine, and tangent.

sub_strands.name: Limits and Rates of Change
performance_indicators: Understand the concept of a limit numerically, graphically, and algebraically.
Calculate the average and instantaneous rates of change for polynomial functions.

sub_strands.name: The Mole Concept and Chemical Equations
performance_indicators: Define the mole as a unit of measurement and calculate molar mass for various compounds.
Perform stoichiometric calculations involving mass-mass and mass-volume relationships in reactions.
Determine empirical and molecular formulas from percentage composition data.

sub_strands.name: Intermolecular Forces and Metallic Bonding
performance_indicators: Differentiate between giant ionic, giant covalent, molecular, and metallic structures.
Relate the physical properties of substances (melting point, conductivity) to their bonding types.

sub_strands.name: Linear Motion and Newton's Laws
performance_indicators: Derive and apply the equations of uniformly accelerated linear motion.
Investigate Newton's three laws of motion through practical experiments.
Solve problems involving momentum, impulse, and the conservation of linear momentum during collisions.

sub_strands.name: Gas Laws and Wave Mechanics
performance_indicators: Verify Boyle's Law, Charles's Law, and the Pressure Law using laboratory apparatus.
Analyze wave parameters (wavelength, frequency, amplitude, speed) using the general wave equation.

sub_strands.name: Cell Organelles and Membrane Transport
performance_indicators: Identify the ultrastructure of plant and animal cells using electron micrographs.
Investigate factors affecting the processes of diffusion, osmosis, and active transport across membranes.
Explain the role of enzymes as biological catalysts and test their sensitivity to temperature and pH changes.

sub_strands.name: Human and Plant Transport Mechanisms
performance_indicators: Describe the structure and mechanism of gaseous exchange in alveoli and stomata.
Examine the composition of blood and trace the structural pathway of systemic and pulmonary circulation.

sub_strands.name: Data Structures and Procedural Programming
performance_indicators: Implement arrays, lists, and basic dictionaries within a high-level programming language.
Write modular scripts utilizing custom functions, parameters, and variable scopes to solve logic problems.
Trace and debug execution errors using manual dry runs and conditional breakpoints.

sub_strands.name: Relational Database Design and Basic SQL
performance_indicators: Design relational schemas by identifying entities, attributes, and primary/foreign key pairs.
Write basic SQL queries utilizing SELECT, WHERE, JOIN, and ORDER BY clauses to extract dataset subsets.

sub_strands.name: Technical Writing and Professional Register
performance_indicators: Draft analytical summaries, project proposals, and clear lab reports using an objective, formal register.
Apply precise syntax transformations including relative clauses and complex conditional structures.

sub_strands.name: Textual Critique and Stylistic Analysis
performance_indicators: Deconstruct literary themes, character development, and socio-cultural commentary within complex plays and novels.
Evaluate informational media articles to flag confirmation bias, logical fallacies, and underlying intents.

sub_strands.name: Uandishi wa Kitaaluma na Uchambuzi wa Lugha
performance_indicators: Kuandika ripoti za kiufundi, makala ya kitaaluma, na insha za hoja kwa kufuata misingi ya lugha sanifu.
Kutumia miundo ya sentensi changamano na vishazi kwa usahihi wa kisarufi katika uwasilishaji.

sub_strands.name: Uhakiki wa Kazi za Fasihi
performance_indicators: Kutathmini dhamira, maudhui, na mitindo ya kisanii katika riwaya na tamthilia teule za Kiswahili.
Kuchambua mashairi ya arudhi na mashairi huru kwa kubainisha ujumbe na matumizi ya lugha ya picha.
